INDIA Bloc Faces Internal Coordination Challenges Three Years On

Three years after its formation, the INDIA opposition alliance continues to operate without a formal coordination committee. Allies have reportedly experienced increasing distance and a lack of coordination. The alliance's structure and functioning have seen limited changes since its inception, with ongoing discussions about how to effectively manage its coalition.
